sentences.text: Rule twenty-seven covers vessels not under command and vessels restricted in their ability to maneuver.
A vessel not under command shows two all-round red lights in a vertical line, and by day two balls.
When making way, she adds sidelights and a sternlight.
A vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver shows three all-round lights in a vertical line, red, white, red, and by day a ball, a diamond and a ball.
When making way, she adds masthead lights, sidelights and a sternlight.
When at anchor, she shows her restricted lights plus her anchor lights.
The special lights tell you about her condition, and the other lights tell you whether she’s moving.
